content: The 'phone-sync-failure' pattern is a durable unresolved failure mode that has been recorded 45 consecutive times without resolution, and consistently co-occurs with ADB device unavailability, phone-sync-import errors, inactive sync timers, and high system resource pressure (disk usage ≥97%, memory 16Gi/23Gi, swap 16Gi/23Gi, load average >3.5).
